verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Usage API, which lets an account read real-time concurrency usage. That suggests a data-engineer could check their concurrency situation programmatically, but nothing states the per-tier concurrent request caps or what it costs to raise them. Missing for 10: documented max concurrency per pricing tier, cost or upgrade path to raise the concurrency cap, explicit confirmation that the Usage API returns the limit and not just current usage, independent corroboration.
